(After you advance to this level, search your Life Deck, discard pile, and Banished Zone for a total of up to 2 Drills and play them.)
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +2 stages of damage and your opponent's attacks deal -2 stages of damage.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
You may destroy a Drill you control. If you do, this attack deals +2 stages of damage for each Drill you control.
DAMAGE: 6 stages.
